quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #13
										  					
  

20 Questions • Passing Score 16

questions.question: When should you use parking lights?

options.text: Only when your vehicle is parked.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only when your vehicle is parked.
questions.explanation: Parking lights are only used when your vehicle is parked.

questions.question: What affects your ability to stop?
questions.explanation: Road conditions greatly affect your ability to stop. Poor road conditions like slippery surfaces require you to slow down to maintain control. If you drive too fast on slippery roads and need to stop, you risk losing control of your vehicle.

questions.question: If you see this sign, what should you do?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. Drivers must obey all regulatory signs. Where this sign is posted, passing other vehicles is not allowed.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT happen after drinking alcohol?

options.text: Your reflexes and reaction time slow down.
Your judgement of speed and distance is distorted.
You calm down and can concentrate better.

questions.correctAnswerText: You calm down and can concentrate better.
questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time, reduces your ability to see clearly, distorts your judgment of speed and distance, reduces your ability to recover from headlight glare, and makes you more likely to take risks.

questions.question: If you drink socially, how can you drive safely?

options.text: Ride home with a friend who has not been drinking.
Take a cold shower before driving.
Stop drinking one half hour before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ride home with a friend who has not been drinking.
questions.explanation: The best way to avoid impaired driving is to arrange a ride with a sober friend. Coffee and cold showers do not reduce blood alcohol content. It takes about one hour for your body to eliminate the alcohol from one drink.

questions.question: What is the most common cause of traffic crashes?
questions.explanation: Crashes often happen when drivers do not see other vehicles or when drivers do something unexpected. Communicate with other drivers to help prevent crashes.

questions.question: What problems do worn or bald tires cause?
questions.explanation: Worn or bald tires increase your stopping distance and make turning more difficult. Tires without good tread also increase the risk of hydroplaning.

questions.question: By law, how far ahead must you signal before a turn or lane change?
questions.explanation: You must signal at least 100 feet before making a turn or lane change. Signaling three to five seconds before is a good way to meet this requirement. Use hand signals if your vehicle's signal lights are not working.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic signal works like:
questions.explanation: A flashing red signal requires you to stop and yield to all traffic that does not have to stop.

questions.question: Your power steering stops working while driving. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn and turn off the ignition.
Turn on your hazard lights and brace yourself.
Work hard to steer, reduce your speed, drive to a safe area, and stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Work hard to steer, reduce your speed, drive to a safe area, and stop.
questions.explanation: Without power steering, you need extra effort to steer. Reduce your speed and pull off the roadway to stop in a safe area.

questions.question: When can you turn right at a red traffic light?

options.text: After you stop behind the stop line.
After you yield to pedestrians and other vehicles.
Unless a sign says you cannot turn right on red.

questions.explanation: You can turn right on red unless a sign says you cannot. You must stop completely before the stop line or crosswalk. Always yield to other vehicles and pedestrians before turning.

questions.question: What happens when a driver goes much slower than the speed limit?

options.text: They are a very safe driver.
They should not let other cars pass.
They may create a dangerous driving environment.

questions.correctAnswerText: They may create a dangerous driving environment.
questions.explanation: Driving much slower than other traffic can be dangerous. If you are on a two-lane road and traffic backs up behind you, pull over and let cars pass. Only drive well below the speed limit when weather or road conditions require it.

questions.question: What does an octagonal sign always mean?
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign is always a stop sign. Come to a complete stop when you see a red, eight-sided sign.

questions.question: How can you reduce the risk of hydroplaning?
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when you drive too fast on wet roads. Driving slower reduces the risk of hydroplaning.

questions.question: Two drivers arrive at a four-way stop at the same time. Who has the right-of-way?

options.text: One driver may continue without stopping.
One driver should honk to give up the right-of-way.

questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, if two drivers arrive at the same time, yield to the driver on your right. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: When driving near a motorcycle, you must:

options.text: Let the motorcycle use a full lane.
Drive on the shoulder beside the motorcycle.
Let the motorcycle use half a lane.
Pass using the same lane as the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the motorcycle use a full lane.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle is a full vehicle with the same road rights as any other vehicle. Give motorcycles a full lane width. They need room to move safely, even if there seems to be space for both vehicles in one lane.

questions.question: What do orange signs mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about work zones on the highway. These diamond-shaped signs have black letters or symbols and alert you that workers are on or near the road.

questions.question: When can you drive through a yellow light?

options.text: When an emergency vehicle is crossing your lane.
When you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you are already in the intersection when the light turns yellow.
questions.explanation: If the light turns yellow while you are already in the intersection, you may drive through carefully.

questions.question: You may pass another vehicle if the line between your lane and the passing lane is a ____ line.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. You can cross broken white lines to pass when the passing lane is clear.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic moves only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign shows that traffic moves only in the direction the arrow points.
